# Overview

Step-by-step instructions for conducting human subject research with the MRI scaner.

# Boot Control System
## Power Up

1. Verify Power Panel is unlocked.
2. Press "System On" button on Power Panel.

![](../../media/pages/boot_1.jpg){width=50% fig-align="center"}

3. Wait for the MRI Control system to boot up.
    * Approx. 10 minutes.
    * System is booted when console displays appear.

![](../../media/pages/boot_2.jpg){width=70% fig-align="center"}

## Power Down
1. Select power button icon in lower right corner of screen.

![](../../media/pages/boot_3.jpg){width=50% fig-align="center"}

2. Select the "Shut Down System" from dropdown menu.

![](../../media/pages/boot_4.jpg){width=50% fig-align="center"}

3. Select "Shut Down" in pop-up window.

![](../../media/pages/boot_5.jpg){width=50% fig-align="center"}

4. Wait until the system shuts down -- the screens will be blank, monitor power buttons red.
5. Push the "System Off" button on the Power Panel.
    * Monitor power buttons should now be dark.

![](../../media/pages/boot_6.jpg){width=50% fig-align="center"}


# Start Session
## Login to Control Computer

1. Select "Unlock" on main screen.

![](../../media/pages/reg_1.jpg){width=70% fig-align="center"}

2. Select "Examination".

![](../../media/pages/reg_2.jpg){width=70% fig-align="center"}

## Register Participant

1. Select "Register Patient".

![](../../media/pages/reg_3.jpg){width=70% fig-align="center"}

![](../../media/pages/reg_4.jpg){width=70% fig-align="center"}

2. Enter "Last Name".
    * Use format "PI Last + Subject ID", e.g. Barbey23
    * ***Do not enter the participant's acutal name.***

![](../../media/pages/reg_5.jpg){width=70% fig-align="center"}

3. Enter "Date of Birth".
    * Specify the first day of the current month.
    * Use participant's birth year.
    * E.g. "12/1/2000" for a scan conducted 12/15/2026 on a participant born in 2000.

![](../../media/pages/reg_6.jpg){width=70% fig-align="center"}

4. Specify "Sex" from the dropdown menu.

![](../../media/pages/reg_7.jpg){width=70% fig-align="center"}

5. Enter Height and Weight.

![](../../media/pages/reg_9.jpg){width=70% fig-align="center"}

6. Specify "Body Part" from the dropdown menu in the lower right corner.

![](../../media/pages/reg_10.jpg){width=70% fig-align="center"}

7. Specify "Patient Orientation".

![](../../media/pages/reg_11.jpg){width=70% fig-align="center"}

8. Select orange "Exam" to begin.

## Front Panel: Jogwheel Control

![Jogwheel Diagram](../../media/pages/mri_jogwheelbuttons.jpg){width=40% fig-align="left"}

1. Table up/inward button
2. Jog wheel, center position (landmark) move to scan
3. Move to home
4. Table down/outward button

Additionally, use "+" to turn alignment light on/off.

Notes:

* Use directional buttons or turn jogwheel to move patients in/out and up/down.
* Horizontal movement speed is faster the farther the wheel is turned.
* Push jogwheel to landmark and move patient in to position for scanning.

To Position:

1. Move table up until it is even with the bore.
1. Turn on the alignment light by pushing "+" button.
1. Move participant in until alignment light is at desired center position.
1. Turn off the alignment light by pushing "+" again.
1. Push the jogwheel and hold (1 second) until table starts to move to the center of the bore.
1. Begin scanning.



# Scan Controls: Basic Screens

## Exam Screen

![](../../media/pages/mri_exam_screen.jpg){width=80% fig-align="center"}

1. Scan Queue: used to program sequences and program control icons.
2. Exam Tool Bar: provide access to functions for setting up and controlling an exam.
3. Planning Segments: displays reference images used for graphical slice positioning.
4. Parameter Card Area: displays the parameter cards of the current protocol and/or user guidance.
5. Variable Segment: shows the inline display or extended third plane planning segment.
6. Stamp Segments: each stamp represents the images of a previously measured series from the current examination.

## View and Go

![](../../media/pages/mri_view_and_go.jpg){width=80% fig-align="center"}

1. Access Bar: contains patient tab and icons to access the patient browser or online help.
2. Case Navigator: contains tabs with processing and viewing options and for printing.
3. Favorite Tools Area: provides access to preferred functions.
4. Image Area: displays images and series in segments.
5. Series Navigator: list all available series for the current patient.
